entities.summary: Bohdan Olexandrovich Blyzniuk is a Ukrainian basketball player for the Kaohsiung Aquas of the Taiwan Professional Basketball League (TPBL). He played college basketball for the Eastern Washington Eagles, where he was named Big Sky Conference Player of the Year in 2018.
